title: Boise X-9 Multi-Use Copy Paper, Ledger 11x17, 1 Ream (500 Sheets), 20 lb, 92 Bright

comparisons.notes: Boise X-9 11x17 ledger, 20 lb, 92 bright, 500-sheet ream (OX-9007RM); same ream as Woot photo
OX-9007, 1 ream 500 sheets 11x17 20 lb 92 bright, UPC 842356055170 matches Woot's ASIN listing

writeup: Woot has a single 500-sheet ream of Boise X-9 multi-use paper in ledger size (11 x 17 inches) for $9.99. It is 20 lb, 92 brightness, acid-free paper made for copiers and printers. The same ream is $25.99 at Union Office Products and $29.39 at Office Depot, and Woot showed only one left.
